title: P1375 – Insufficient RMP Increase During Spark Test
description: Insufficient RMP Increase During Spark Test Diagnostic trouble code P1375. Confirm with a scan tool and vehicle-specific service data.
symptoms: Check engine light or stored DTC present

Clear codes only after repair and confirm monitors complete
